doc_summary: On the authoritative server tick, `native_clip(dimension, from, to)` clips a segment against block collider shapes; `native_box_collides(dimension, min, max)` checks block collisions only. Both use an empty entity context, ignore fluids, treat unloaded chunks as empty, and never load a dimension or chunk. Each has a budget of 512 calls per mod per tick; oversized queries and collision errors return an error. Bundles need fragment @API:server_block_collision@.
